build_openpangu_mtp_model: build an OpenPanguMTP model instance for multi-token prediction using vLLM speculative decoding
create_multi_token_predictor_layer: create an OpenPanguMultiTokenPredictorLayer with RMSNorm, linear projection, and decoder block components
run_openpangu_mtp_forward: run the OpenPanguMTP forward pass with input ids, positions, and hidden states for speculative token generation
load_openpangu_mtp_weights: load and map checkpoint weights into OpenPanguMTP with fused MoE and QKV fusion support
compute_openpangu_mtp_logits: compute logits from hidden states using the shared head and logits processor in OpenPanguMultiTokenPredictor
